messages:
tony (newhire): morning folks, small blocker on day 1. i accepted the GitHub invite but the org isn't visible and private repos 404. clicking the invite link shows "Organization requires SAML SSO" and then a web page error. i'm signed into my personal account in the browser, could that be it? :confused:
nick (it-support): hey tony, welcome! yes multiple accounts often cause that. what email did the invite go to and what's your GH username? we enforce SAML SSO + 2FA.
tony (newhire): invite came to tony+redwood@protonmail.com, username is tonycodes. i tried in incognito and still get an error after the SSO redirect: "SCIM: no user mapping found".
scim-bot: SCIM system note: mapping lookup failed for tony+redwood@protonmail.com at 2025-01-08T09:14Z. Possible mismatch between idp:mail and invite email.
nick (it-support): that error usually means the identity provider email doesn't match the invite. two options: 1) add the invited email to your GH account and verify it, or 2) we can change the invite to match the email in your GitHub profile (admin-side). which do you prefer?
ton (newhire): i'll add the work alias to my GH account and verify. 
marco (manager): marco here, ping me when tony is in and i'll pre-approve read access to benchmarking and runtime for ramp week.
onboard-bot: quick checklist: 1) Accept org invite 2) Connect SSO 3) Enable 2FA (webauthn or TOTP) + save recovery codes 4) Add SSH key -> https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/git
tony (newhire): added tony+redwood@protonmail.com to GH, verified, accepted invite. SSO prompted for 2FA and i did TOTP with Authy. now i can see the org but don't have repo access yet.
devops: welcome tony 44b we give new hires read+PR by default on code repos. private infra and benchmarking are gated by manager approval. marco, can you confirm?
marco (manager): approved for read access to benchmarking and runtime for onboarding week.
scim-bot: Admin action: assigned team membership eng-benchmark to tony (tonycodes) via SCIM at 2025-01-08T09:24Z. Pending repo grants: benchmarking, runtime.
devops: added tony to team "eng-benchmark" and granted repo read on redwood-inference/benchmarking and redwood-inference/runtime. you should be able to clone now. for CI access we will provision a deploy key per machine.
ton (newhire): tried to clone `git@github.com:redwood-inference/benchmarking.git` and got "Permission denied (publickey)". i added my SSH pub key to GH but local agent might not have it.
nick (it-support): run `ssh -T git@github.com` and if it fails `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` or `eval $(ssh-agent -s) && ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. also ensure the key type is supported (ed25519 preferred).
ton (newhire): after `ssh-add` `ssh -T` says "Hi tonycodes! You've successfully authenticated". clone works now. opened a tiny docs PR. first day win :tada:
devops: one more note: for push rights to benchmarking we require a short justification + manager sign-off and completion of the security mini-course. see https://redwood.example.com/security/mini-course.
marco (manager): sign-off ok if needed later, start with read+PR.
ton (newhire): got it. also FYI i use a YubiKey for 2FA on other accounts, any gotchas?
nick (it-support): hardware keys are fine. sometimes the SSO flow initially wants a TOTP fallback; enable TOTP temporarily if you hit webauthn failures then re-register your YubiKey afterwards. we documented this in the onboarding guide.
onboard-bot: automated: added tony to team eng-benchmark, set onboarding task status to "git access complete". If anything else breaks ping #help or DM IT. :white_check_mark:
